title: The Hide privacy checkboxes on the AWS DLP integration: per-role defaults for admins, end users and managers or approvers, and their dependencies
aliases: aws hide policy details for non-triggered matches

prose.label: Dependencies.
prose.text: {{non-triggered-dependency}} {{no-read-access-consequence}} The defaults of the end user and manager non-triggered checkboxes are not on the page {{gap:non-triggered-defaults}}. The integration these belong to is [[zwa.aws-dlp-integration]], and the CloudFormation stack read access setting is in [[zwa.aws-dlp-integration.cloudformation-parameters]].

checks.do: Whether Hide Evidence Data or Hide Trigger Data is selected for the role in question, and whether read access to the S3 bucket was enabled when the stack was created.

admin-settings.statement: For admins, Hide Evidence Data - Admin and Hide Trigger Data - Admin are selected by default and Hide Policy Details - Admin is not selected by default.

quotes: Hide Evidence Data - Admin: Select if you do not want admins to be able to generate presigned evidence links for an incident on the Violation Content tab of the Incident Details drawer. Otherwise, they can generate evidence links. This checkbox is selected by default.

Hide Trigger Data - Admin: Select if you do not want admins to be able to see the trigger data for an incident on the Violation Content tab of the Incident Details drawer. Otherwise, they can see the trigger data. This checkbox is selected by default.

Hide Policy Details - Admin: Select if you do not want the admins to be able to view any of the policy details for the incident on the Violation Details tab of the Incident Details drawer. Otherwise, they can view the policy details for the incident. This checkbox is not selected by default.

end-user-settings.statement: For end users responding to an incident notification, Hide Evidence Data - End User, Hide Trigger Data - End User and Hide Policy Details - End User are each selected by default.

quotes: Hide Evidence Data - End User: Select if you do not want the end users responding to an incident notification to be able to generate presigned evidence links for an incident. Otherwise, they can generate evidence links. This checkbox is selected by default.

Hide Trigger Data - End User: Select if you do not want the end users responding to an incident notification to be able to see the trigger data for an incident. Otherwise, they can see the trigger data. This checkbox is selected by default.

Hide Policy Details - End User: Select if you do not want the end users responding to an incident notification to be able to view any of the policy details for the incident. Otherwise, they can view the policy details for the incident. This checkbox is selected by default.

manager-settings.statement: For approvers or managers responding to an incident escalation notification, Hide Evidence Data - Manager/Approver, Hide Trigger Data - Manager/Approver and Hide Policy Details - Manager/Approver are each selected by default.

quotes: Hide Evidence Data - Manager/Approver: Select if you do not want the approvers or managers responding to an incident escalation notification to be able to generate presigned evidence links for the incident. Otherwise, they can generate evidence links. This checkbox is selected by default.

Hide Trigger Data - Manager/Approver: Select if you do not want the approvers or managers responding to an incident escalation notification to be able to see the trigger data for the incident. Otherwise, they can see the trigger data. This checkbox is selected by default.

Hide Policy Details - Manager/Approver: Select if you do not want the approvers or managers responding to an incident escalation notification to be able to view the policy details for the incident. Otherwise, they can view the policy details for the incident. This checkbox is selected by default.

non-triggered-dependency.statement: The Hide Policy Details for Non-Triggered Matches checkbox (Non-Triggered Engines and Dictionaries and Other Matched Rules sections) is only available when the matching Hide Policy Details checkbox is not selected, for each of Admin, End User and Manager/Approver; for Admin it is not selected by default.

quotes: Hide Policy Details for Non-Triggered Matches - Admin: Select if you do not want the admins to be able to view the Non-Triggered Engines and Dictionaries section and the Other Matched Rules section of the policy details

Hide Policy Details for Non-Triggered Matches - End User: Select if you do not want the end users responding to an incident notification to be able to view the Non-Triggered Engines and Dictionaries section and the Other Matched Rules section

Hide Policy Details for Non-Triggered Matches - Manager/Approver: Select if you do not want the approvers or managers responding to an incident escalation notification to be able to view the Non-Triggered Engines and Dictionaries section and the Other Matched Rules section
This checkbox is only available if you do not select the Hide Policy Details - Admin checkbox. This checkbox is not selected by default.
This checkbox is only available if you do not select the Hide Policy Details - End User checkbox.
This checkbox is only available if you do not select the Hide Policy Details - Manager/Approver checkbox.

no-read-access-consequence.statement: If Hide Evidence Data or Hide Trigger Data is disabled but read access to the S3 bucket was not enabled when the CloudFormation stack was created, no one can generate evidence links or view trigger data in the Zscaler Admin Console.

quotes: If you disable Hide Evidence Data or Hide Trigger Data in the integration, but you did not enable read access to the S3 bucket when creating the CloudFormation stack, no one can generate evidence links or view trigger data in the Zscaler Admin Console.

non-triggered-defaults.title: Are Hide Policy Details for Non-Triggered Matches - End User and - Manager/Approver selected by default?
non-triggered-defaults.detail: The page states 'not selected by default' only for the Admin checkbox; the End User and Manager/Approver entries give no default.
